# Requirements Agent Adapter

Canonical role: `.agents/agents/requirements.md`.

Before acting:

1. Read `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read the canonical Requirements Agent definition.
3. Follow `docs/process/ai-workflow.md` and `docs/process/development-process.md`.
4. Resolve current Decision / Issue / Evidence state before making a status claim.
5. Use `.agents/orchestration/handoff-format.md` when handing work to another Agent.

Do not create new governance semantics in this adapter.
Do not weaken Human GO, permission, security, or production boundaries.
Stop at the next gate required by the canonical workflow.
